skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand current issues and trends in the hospitality industry.
Analyze and discuss new business issues and trends.
Effectively present and communicate ideas in a professional setting.
Collaborate effectively in group projects and discussions.
Demonstrate a high level of responsibility, integrity, and respect for cultural traditions.
Show a strong commitment to customer service and cultural preservation.
Identify and solve problems related to hotel operations.
Demonstrate leadership in group activities and presentations.
Manage time effectively during group projects and presentations.
Understand and apply digital trends in the hospitality industry.
Recognize and address environmental issues in hospitality management.
